12 / 21 · Projection

Health propagation

A health projection aggregates dependency signals into service or capability properties. Its rule defines how dependency states determine the result.

Contract illustration
Master graphProjection
◉ Active+ Added− RemovedΔ Changed× Rejected
The rule
What the contract requires
Make the rule part of the projection: for example, any required dependency failing makes the service degraded.
The boundary
Scope and constraints
Each health projection defines its own interpretation. A causal diagnosis would require additional evidence and rules.
Example · C#
Aggregate dependency health
Full source ↗
Group by service and ask whether any dependency has failed.
UsageExamples.cs
public static GroupOperator AnyFailedDependency() =>
    new(new OperatorId("service-health"),
        [new("service", new FieldExpression("service"))],
        [new("degraded", AggregateFunction.Any,
            new CallExpression(Function.Equal,
                [new FieldExpression("dependencyHealth"),
                 new Literal(new TextValue("failed"))]))]);
// Upstream rows supply service and dependencyHealth. A downstream emitter
// maps the Boolean aggregate into a property declared by its output ontology.
Compile-checked caller example. Execution requires implementations of the injected interfaces.
